items.name: 〜られる・〜える (可能形)
items.summary: The potential form expresses ability or possibility. Ru-verbs take られる; u-verbs shift the final sound to the e-row + る (話す→話せる).

items.name: あげる・くれる・もらう
items.summary: あげる (give, from the speaker's side), くれる (give, toward the speaker), and もらう (receive) mark the direction of a transfer between people.
